architecture: shared semantics, independent implementations, contract-based conformance

digests.legacy_bare_64_hex: adapt as sha-256; never rewrite persisted payloads

gap_matrix.inventory: lukart-work has explicit per-type URNs; no shared cross-repo evidence/result/report identity
gap_matrix.resolution: explicit neutral schema IDs in this bundle

gap_matrix.inventory: both repositories sort JSON keys and remove insignificant whitespace, but the profile was implicit
gap_matrix.resolution: named deterministic canonical JSON profile; adapters preserve historical bytes

gap_matrix.inventory: legacy contracts use bare SHA-256 hex values
gap_matrix.resolution: algorithm-tagged digest envelope supports SHA-256 and SHA-512; legacy values adapt as SHA-256

gap_matrix.inventory: lukart-work stores content_hash separately from artifact identity; H3 evidence is a bounded reference
gap_matrix.resolution: immutable evidence envelope with digest-derived evidence_id

gap_matrix.inventory: lukart-work has rich domain provenance; H3 evidence/result carries execution references
gap_matrix.resolution: neutral provenance envelope binding producer, operation, implementation digest, inputs and source refs

gap_matrix.inventory: lukart-work has CommandResult/AIResult/IngestionResult/ReleaseResult; H3 has one operation status vocabulary
gap_matrix.resolution: neutral result envelope plus backward-compatible adapters

gap_matrix.inventory: stage reports are machine-readable but stage-specific; text/Markdown are presentation
gap_matrix.resolution: canonical report envelope; derived Markdown renderer reads only machine-readable bundle data
pinned profiles, synthetic fixtures, adversarial tests and dedicated CI gate

invariants: actual effects are a subset of declared effects
effects are permitted only for success or partial results
PASS reports require every check to PASS
evidence_id is derived from the algorithm-tagged content digest
provenance explicitly binds producer, operation, implementation and inputs
legacy persisted payloads are adapted, not rewritten
fixtures contain synthetic CASE-TESTY data only
Markdown/HTML/PDF are derived views and never authoritative
